input_provenance: Existing 80cb324 cross-artifact packet; consumed file hashes reverified against the gated offline stage receipt. Original CPU corner streams have separate same-hash provenance.
scope: 105 selected skin samples; all roots exactly identity; 32 single positive influence with weight1. Separate/glam baseline reproduces every recorded modeled bone output and all105 original CPU world tuples.
bone_family: 24 permutations of x,y,z,translation terms in a left-fold chain; first product rounded to f32; each of3 additions independently either adds an already rounded product or correctly rounds the exact product+accumulator as fma.192 fixed matrix families. Same family applies to every bone/component/sample.
accumulation_family: Source order across positive influences, from f32 zero; either independently rounded weight multiplication then addition, or correctly rounded fma(bone_component,weight,accumulator). No renormalization.
limits: A numerical family fit is not an observation of emitted/executed instructions or proof of causality.
These are saved instrumented skin/world observations. Both same-pass clips matching the earlier instrumented clip probe does not establish unchanged production optimization.
No GPU execution, game build, source changes, or strict-image predicate changes.
The tested family is bounded to fixed left-fold dot chains and source-ordered accumulation; failure is not proof that no other arithmetic model can fit.

independent_libm_validation.implementation: system libm fmaf through ctypes, native CPU only
independent_libm_validation.scope: Independent verification of the mathematical family, not GPU instruction inspection

single_influence_exact_mathematical_erro.scope: Exact rational sum of the original f32 matrix coefficients times point components. Closer to the mathematical result does not change the strict CPU-reference parity contract.

bone_component_sequence: q = RN(m_x * p_x + q), fused multiply-add
q = RN(m_z * p_z + q), fused multiply-add
simplest_complete_fit.ordered_influence_accumulation: position_component = RN(q * weight + position_component), fused multiply-add, positive influences in original slot order
simplest_complete_fit.equivalent_translation_variant: RN(m_translation * 1 + q) is numerically indistinguishable here because multiplication by1 is exact.
